comment: Copy to users.json and fill in real logins. The Indent module sweep (tests/indent-module) needs ONE account: it reads 'tester', falling back to 'raiser'. Everything it asserts is recomputed from what that account can see, so the same run is correct for a store keeper, a manager or an administrator. 'approvers' and 'inventory' are needed only by the cross-login journey suites (tests/indent-approval-flow, tests/inventory-warehouse-flow); every account in 'approvers' is tried against /api/workflow/pending at each rung, so the ladder can change without touching a test. Optional 'position' picks which hat the person wears — scope and permissions follow the active position, so someone can be blind to a document under one and own it under another.
